It's not too bad for the draw- considering that you are carrying in deep concealment. There is always a catch 22 between the amount of concealability and speed of draw. It will ultimately be up to you how quick you want to draw in comparison to how well hidden the pistol will be.

As for comfort, it is just a stretchy band around your middle. Some people are more sensitive to this than others, but it only ever bothered me when I had it adjusted too tight. It took a while, and only happened once.

Pocket holster works better. Belly bands don't breathe fir shit, either. Uncomfortable, awkward, and suck at retention. You can wear a belt inside your shorts. Belly bands suck. Thunderwear is another good option for Texas summers.

The bad things: I have yet to find one that likes to stay velcroed. I like to use it when running, and it likes to try and fall off. Eventually, you learn to fold the top part down over the velcro, or wear it so the waits of your shorts holds the velcro.
